verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a work-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a vendor-hosted model: apps run on monday's infrastructure, and the docs say data never leaves monday's servers. The open-source Vibe React components are UI building blocks, not the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
